subject: Exec Sprint: slotting, presenter rotations, and preread curation
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-10-28T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Exec sprint — initial slotting + preread ask

Team — kicking off the slotting for Acme’s Nov 10–11 exec sprint. Draft agenda attached (short, 90/60/30 windows). Two immediate asks: 1) confirm presenter assignments for each 45–60m block, and 2) curate a one-page preread per presenter (technical summary + 3 bullets of expected decisions).

Key constraints from Acme: no executive leadership sessions after 3pm local, and procurement needs an updated T&C appendix before Nov 2.

I attached a slotting matrix (sheet per day) — fill your name in the "presenter" column and add a link to your preread doc. Please update by COB Mon (10/30).

Attachments: 20261103-draft-agenda.pdf (pdf), slotting-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Program Lead, Customer Engagement
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec sprint — initial slotting + preread ask

Aisha — I put myself down for Day 1: 11:00–12:00 (Platform roadmap + Q&A). I'll prepare a 1‑pager covering: overview, performance commitments (latency/SLOs), and customer impact examples.

Two notes: 1) Can we move "Scaling patterns" earlier to avoid the 3pm cutoff? 2) I started a doc for the preread in the Drive link you shared — link added in the sheet.

On the procurement appendix — I can work with Ben on the technical appendix (data residency + key management) if you want me to draft it by Nov 1.

—Marcus

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec sprint — initial slotting + preread ask

Looks good. I took Day 2 morning for the "Security & Compliance" deep dive (60m) — will attach SOC2 checklist and a 1-page summary of controls. Marcus, happy to co-author the technical appendix with you; I have the KMS/HSM integration doc.

Aisha: small ask — can we add a single slide that lists "decision points" per session (yes/no/needs follow-up)? That will help Acme track outcomes and owners.

Attachment stubs: soc2-checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: Emily Ross <emily.ross@acme.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Joshua Lee <joshua@brightpath.co>, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-11-01T08:33:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Exec sprint — initial slotting + preread ask

Thanks, Aisha — this looks great. Quick clarifications from our side: 1) prefer the "Security & Compliance" slot to be Day 1 afternoon (we want execs to review it before the product deep dive), and 2) prereads need to be with attendees by Nov 5 EOD.

Procurement: please confirm if the T&C appendix can be a separate deliverable (we can accept it up to Nov 6) — procurement@acme.com is on copy.

We also requested a short "how we measure success" slide per session — 2 bullets max. Can your presenters include that in their preread?

—Emily

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
To: Emily Ross <emily.ross@acme.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Joshua Lee <joshua@brightpath.co>
Date: 2026-11-03T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec sprint — initial slotting + preread ask

Thanks for the tempo, Emily. Updated plan based on the group: 1) Move "Security & Compliance" to Day 1, 2) Decision‑point slide added to the prep checklist, and 3) prereads due Nov 5 EOD — I updated the Drive bundle and attached a zipped preread skeleton. Marcus/Ben: confirm the appendix handoff — Marcus to draft Nov 1, Ben to finalize Nov 5.

Next steps (short):
- Marcus: share final 1‑pager + success bullets by EOD Nov 2
- Ben: SOC2 summary + appendix details by Nov 5
- Evelyn: attendee logistics and room set (AV/remote) — confirm by Nov 4

Attachments: preread-bundle-v1.zip (zip)

If no objections, I'll send the final agenda and attendee invite on Nov 6 morning.

Aisha
